```{r}
total <- read_csv("TOTAL CONFLICTS.csv")
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Create a new column categorizing designations based on the number of conflicts
total$conflict_occuring <- ifelse(total$Total > 0, "1+ Conflicts", "0 Conflicts")

specific_desig <- c("Community Conservancy", "Community Nature Reserve", "National Park", "Private Ranch", "National Reserve", "Forest Reserve")
df_filtered <- total %>%
  filter(DESIG %in% specific_desig)

# Ensure every DESIG has both conflict categories
df_for_plot <- df_filtered %>%
  count(DESIG, conflict_occuring) %>%
  complete(DESIG, conflict_occuring, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  rename(Count = n)

library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)


ggplot(df_for_plot, aes(y = str_wrap(DESIG, width = 20), x = Count, fill = conflict_occuring)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1+ Conflicts" = "steelblue", "0 Conflicts" = "lightblue")) +
  labs(title = "Number of Designations by Conflict Status",
       y = "Designation",
       x = "Count",
       fill = "Conflict Status") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        legend.position = "top")

```

barplot to plot types of protected areas
```{r}
type <- c("Community Conservancy", "Community Nature Reserve", "Forest Reserve", "National Park", "National Reserve", "Private Reserve")
count <- c(21, 28, 234, 23, 29, 16)
par(mar = c(5, 6, 4, 2) + 1)
concount <- data.frame(type, count)
barplot(concount$count, names.arg = concount$type, horiz=TRUE, las = 1, col = "lightblue", 
        main = "Types of Protected Areas", xlab = "Count of Each Type", cex.names=0.58, xlim = c(0, 250))
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)


# Creating the data frame
type <- c("Community Conservancy", "Community Nature Reserve", "Forest Reserve", "National Park", "National Reserve", "Private Reserve")
count <- c(21, 28, 234, 23, 29, 16)
concount <- data.frame(type, count)

# Generating rainbow colors
colors <- rainbow(length(unique(concount$type)))

ggplot(concount, aes(x = reorder(type, count), y = count, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Types of Protected Areas",
       x = "Count of Each Type",
       y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = rel(0.8)),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none")  # Remove the legend
```

```{r}
NDVI$date <- as.Date(NDVI$date, format="%Y-%m-%d")
NDVI$year <- format(NDVI$date, "%Y")
NDVI$vim <- as.numeric(as.character(NDVI$vim))
ndvi_yearly <- NDVI %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(NDVI_vim = mean(vim, na.rm = TRUE))

table(NDVI$year)
summary(NDVI$vim)

ndvi_conflict <- merge(annual_rainfall, ndvi_yearly, by = "year", all.x = TRUE)

install.packages("scales")

library(scales)

# Correctly rescale NDVI values to [0, 1]
ndvi_conflict$NDVI_vim_rescaled <- scales::rescale(ndvi_conflict$NDVI_vim, c(0, 1), na.rm = TRUE)


model <- lm(NRT ~ NDVI_vim + `election year` + (NDVI_vim * `election year`), data = ndvi_conflict)
summary(model)
library(xtable)
print(xtable(model), type = "latex") # or type = "latex"
```
```{r}
library(readr)
area_conflict <- read_csv("~/Desktop/folder/Thesis/attribute table conflicts inside conservancies - Sheet6.csv")
# Ensure 'conflicts/square km' is numeric
area_conflict$`conflicts/square km` <- as.numeric(as.character(area_conflict$`conflicts/hectare`))
area_conflict$designation <- as.factor(area_conflict$DESIG)
area_conflict$designation <- relevel(area_conflict$designation, ref = "National Sanctuary")
model <- lm(`conflicts/hectare` ~ designation, data = area_conflict)
summary(model)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(stringr) # Ensure stringr is loaded for str_wrap

filtered_data <- area_conflict %>%
  filter(!designation %in% c("Ramsar Site, Wetland of International Importance", "Wildlife Sanctuary", "World Heritage Site (natural or mixed)", "Marine National Reserve", "National Sanctuary", "Group Ranch"))

average_conflicts <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(designation) %>%
  summarize(Avg_Conflicts_per_sq_km = mean(`conflicts/square km`, na.rm = TRUE),
            SE = sd(`conflicts/square km`, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()))  # n() gives the number of observations

# Wrap text for designation labels
average_conflicts$designation_wrapped <- str_wrap(average_conflicts$designation, width = 20)

# Plotting the averages with standard error bars, using wrapped text for labels and making bars horizontal
ggplot(average_conflicts, aes(x = designation_wrapped, y = Avg_Conflicts_per_sq_km, fill = designation_wrapped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Avg_Conflicts_per_sq_km - SE, ymax = Avg_Conflicts_per_sq_km + SE), width = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +  # Flip the coordinates to make the bars horizontal
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average Conflicts per 100 Square Km by Designation", 
       y = "Conflicts per 100 Square Km",  # Swap x and y labels after flipping
       x = "Average Conflicts per 100 Square Km",
       fill = "Designation") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))  # Ensure y-axis labels (original x-axis) are horizontal

```

isolate farmer herder conflicts
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Assuming 'conflict_data' is your dataset
# And you want to check columns 'description1', 'description2', etc.

# Creating a new dataframe with rows containing the keywords in any of the specified columns
farmer_herder_conflicts <- acled %>%
  rowwise() %>%  # Apply the filtering function to each row individually
  filter(str_detect(assoc_actor_1, regex("Pastoralists", ignore_case = TRUE)) |
         str_detect(assoc_actor_2, regex("Pastoralists", ignore_case = TRUE)) |
         str_detect(notes, regex("herders|pastoralists", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup()  # Remove the row wise grouping
write.csv(farmer_herder_conflicts, "farmer_herder_conflicts.csv")
farmerherdertable <- table(farmer_herder_conflicts$year)
acledtable <- table(acled$year)
```

```{r}
farmerherderdf <- as.data.frame(farmerherdertable)
acleddf <- as.data.frame(acledtable)

merged_df <- merge(farmerherderdf, acleddf, by = c("Var1", "Var1"))
merged_df$Ratio = with(merged_df, (Freq.x / Freq.y)*100)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = Var1, y = Ratio)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +  # Set bars to be steelblue
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(title = "Percentage of Total Recorded Conflicts that Involve Pastoralists",
       x = "Year", 
       y = "Percentage") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))



```
```{r}
phytomass_grid <- read_csv("phytomass grid.csv")
# Perform a t-test
t_test_result <- t.test(NMdata.phytomass ~ in_protected_area, data = phytomass_grid)

# Print the results
print(t_test_result)

install.packages("xtable")
# Example t-test
t_test_result <- t.test(rnorm(10), rnorm(10))
# Extracting key components from the t-test result
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Statistic = t_test_result$statistic,
  p_value = t_test_result$p.value,
  Confidence_Interval_Lower = t_test_result$conf.int[1],
  Confidence_Interval_Upper = t_test_result$conf.int[2],
  Estimate_Difference = t_test_result$estimate,
  Degrees_of_Freedom = t_test_result$parameter
)
# Convert the data frame to LaTeX
latex_table <- xtable(summary_df)

# Print the LaTeX code
print(latex_table, type = "latex", floating = FALSE)

```
```{r}
pastoralismPA <- read_csv("pastoralist violence inside PA.csv")
pastoralismPA <- pastoralismPA %>% filter(NUMPOINTS > 0)
library(dplyr)

# Assuming NUMPOINT is the variable of interest and you want the count of non-zero NUMPOINT entries per DESIG
filtered_data <- pastoralismPA %>%
  filter(NUMPOINTS > 0) %>%
  group_by(DESIG) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(),  # Count of entries for each designation
            SE = sd(NUMPOINTS) / sqrt(n()), .groups = 'drop')  # Standard error of NUMPOINT
# Assuming normal distribution, the error margin can be approximated as 1 standard error from the mean
filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(Lower = Count - SE, Upper = Count + SE)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)  # Make sure to load the stringr package for str_wrap

ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = DESIG, y = Count, fill = DESIG)) +  # Add fill = DESIG here
  geom_col() +  # Draw bars
  coord_flip() +  # Make bars horizontal
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 20)) +  # Wrap long labels
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Count of Designations with 1 or More Conflict",
       x = "Designation of Protected Area",
       y = "Count") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")  # Keep this if you don't want a legend


```
